data.heading: Terms at a glance
data.subheading: A plain-language summary. The full terms apply.

items.question: Your account
items.answer: You are responsible for activity on your account and for keeping your login details secure.

items.question: Acceptable use
items.answer: Do not use the service to send spam, distribute malware or break the law.

items.question: Payment
items.answer: Subscriptions renew automatically. You can cancel before the renewal date from your billing page.

items.question: Termination
items.answer: Either of us can end the agreement with 30 days notice. We will export your data on request.

items.question: Liability
items.answer: Our liability is limited to the fees you paid in the previous twelve months.
